answer: Convict agents into a stake-graded identity registry, then for each task sample a quorum of graders uniformly at random from members whose standing exceeds a threshold, like picking summiteers from a nebula of climbers rather than letting newcomers wander in and vote. Work is scored by quorum median, so inflating a verdict requires controlling most of the sampled quorum. An attacker must stake capital on many aged identities, and each busted vote burns that stake, making sybil farming costlier than honest participation.
